title: 4 places that sound fake but are real (English)
sources: NOAA Ocean Service, 'What is the Bloop?': https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/bloop.html (recorded 1997 by underwater microphones more than 3,219 km apart; an icequake, ice cracking off an Antarctic glacier)
Popular Science, 'The sea monster goes bloop, or does it?': https://www.popsci.com/environment/sea-monster-bloop-sound/ (1997; consistent with icequakes)

Central Asia Guide, Darvaza Gas Crater (checked Nov 2026): https://central-asia.guide/turkmenistan/destinations-tr/darvaza-gas-crater/ (burning for decades, still burning but much smaller; origin disputed)
Getaway, 'The Door to Hell' (Sept 2026): https://www.getaway.co.za/travel/travel-ideas/door-to-hell-turkmenistan-darvaza-gas-crater/ (more than 50 years; only isolated areas of fire in 2025)
National Geographic Education, Antarctica: https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/antarctica/ (no permanent residents; about 1,000 people in winter)
Cool Antarctica, Can you live in Antarctica?: https://www.coolantarctica.com/Antarctica%20fact%20file/science/can_you_live_in_antarctica.php (no permanent residents; about 1,000 people overwinter)

British Antarctic Survey, The Antarctic Treaty leaflet: https://www.bas.ac.uk/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/public_information_leaflet_the_antarctic_treaty.pdf (research stations; about 1,000 people in winter)
HISTORY, Derinkuyu underground city: https://www.history.com/articles/derinkuyu-turkey-underground-city (at least 18 levels, up to 20,000 people)
IFLScience, Derinkuyu: https://www.iflscience.com/derinkuyu-the-ancient-underground-cave-city-that-can-house-20000-people-69287 (18 levels, as many as 20,000 people)

lines.text: Four places that sound fake, but are real!
One: the Door to Hell. This gas crater in Turkmenistan has burned for decades,
lines.caps: one: the | *door to *hell. | this gas crater | in *turkmenistan | has burned | for *decades,

lines.text: though its fire is much smaller now.
lines.caps: though its fire | is much *smaller now.

lines.text: Two: the Bloop, a giant ocean sound from nineteen ninety seven.
lines.caps: two: the *bloop, | a giant *ocean sound | from *nineteen ninety seven.

lines.text: The cause? Ice cracking off Antarctica!
Three: Antarctica has no permanent residents. Only about a thousand people stay for winter.

lines.text: Four: under Turkey hides a city, at least eighteen levels deep, with room for twenty thousand people!

lines.text: Which would you visit: the fire crater, or the hidden city?
